hypotheses.justification: Set f := μ.rnDeriv ν, which is measurable by measurable_rnDeriv. The fiber S := {y | f y = f x} is measurable and contains x. Using restrict_withDensity, withDensity_congr_ae, and withDensity_const gives (ν.withDensity f).restrict S = f x • ν.restrict S. Evaluate at {x} and use restrict_apply' and smul_apply to obtain ν.withDensity f {x} = f x * ν {x}, without requiring {x} measurable. The original argument showing the singular part vanishes uses no measurable-singleton assumption; combine it with this identity and haveLebesgueDecomposition_add. These lemmas allow zero or infinite density and infinite singleton mass, so no exceptional cases require the deleted assumption.
